## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.operandAttachment property

How an [EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.operandOptions](./sh-analysis.embeddedcommandinterpreterspec.operandoptions.md) letter receives its operand inside a clustered word:

- `'separate-word'` — always the next word; remaining letters in the cluster are still options (`bash -oc errexit 'cmd'` is `-o errexit -c`<!-- -->). - `'rest-of-cluster'` — the remainder of the word if any, else the next word; later letters in the same word are part of the operand (`zsh -oc` names an option `c`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly operandAttachment: "separate-word" | "rest-of-cluster";
```
